name: writing-signal
description: Private, local-first writing and clipboard insights for Raycast.
title: Writing Signal
author: paranjay

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Open Writing Dashboard
commands.description: See local writing-time, text-pattern, and clipboard summaries.

commands.name: capture-writing-snapshot
commands.title: Capture Writing Snapshot
commands.description: Measure the selected text without storing its contents.

commands.name: start-writing-session
commands.title: Start Writing Session
commands.description: Start an intentional local writing-time session.

commands.name: start-activity-timer
commands.title: Start Activity Timer
commands.description: Track writing, creating, focused work, or consuming.

commands.name: start-focus-block
commands.title: Start Focus Block
commands.description: Start a local timed writing, creating, focus, or consuming block.

commands.name: focus-block-pulse
commands.title: Focus Block Timer
commands.description: Completes due local focus blocks and saves their exact planned duration.

commands.name: stop-writing-session
commands.title: Stop Writing Session
commands.description: Stop the active writing-time session.

commands.name: log-activity
commands.title: Log Past Activity
commands.description: Add time that already passed, without storing what you did.

commands.name: clipboard-insights
commands.title: Open Clipboard Insights
commands.description: Inspect and classify the current clipboard without saving its contents.

commands.name: clipboard-pulse
commands.title: Enable Clipboard Pattern Tracking
commands.description: Track local clipboard text patterns without storing clipboard content.

commands.name: clipboard-patterns
commands.title: Open Clipboard Patterns
commands.description: See local aggregate clipboard copy patterns from the enabled tracker.

commands.name: purge-clipboard
commands.title: Purge Clipboard
commands.description: Clear the current macOS clipboard after confirmation.

commands.name: privacy-and-data
commands.title: Open Privacy & Data
commands.description: Review local data handling or erase all Writing Signal data.

commands.name: screen-time
commands.title: Open Automatic Screen Time
commands.description: See app-level time from the local native companion.

commands.name: collector-status
commands.title: Open Collector Status
commands.description: See the native companion's privacy settings and live status.

commands.name: collector-setup
commands.title: Set up Automatic Tracking
commands.description: Build and install the local native collector with clear consent choices.

commands.name: activity-menu-bar
commands.title: Activity at a Glance
commands.description: Show current activity and today's local screen time in the menu bar.

commands.name: app-rules
commands.title: Manage App Rules
commands.description: Override automatic categories for the apps you use.

commands.name: privacy-exclusions
commands.title: Manage Privacy Exclusions
commands.description: Choose apps the native collector must never record.

commands.name: browser-pulse
commands.title: Enable Browser Activity Tracking
commands.description: Track active website hostnames locally, with no URL paths or page content.

commands.name: browser-time
commands.title: Open Browser Time
commands.description: See local time by website hostname from the enabled browser tracker.

commands.name: browser-rules
commands.title: Manage Browser Rules
commands.description: Override the category assigned to browser hostnames.

commands.name: browser-exclusions
commands.title: Manage Browser Exclusions
commands.description: Choose hostnames browser tracking must never record.

commands.name: activity-timeline
commands.title: Open Activity Timeline
commands.description: See local foreground-app segments from today.

commands.name: insights
commands.title: Open Personal Activity Insights
commands.description: See a local summary of writing, creating, consuming, apps, and browser activity.

commands.name: weekly-review
commands.title: Open Weekly Review
commands.description: See seven days of local app time, writing, intentional activity, and keyboard estimates.

commands.name: goals
commands.title: Set Daily Goals
commands.description: Set optional daily writing, focused-work, and creating targets.

commands.name: daily-review-settings
commands.title: Daily Check-In Settings
commands.description: Choose an optional local daily writing and time-balance summary.

commands.name: daily-review-pulse
commands.title: Daily Check-In
commands.description: Show the optional local daily writing and activity summary at your chosen hour.

commands.name: export-data
commands.title: Export Local Data
commands.description: Write a private local JSON snapshot of your aggregates and settings.

commands.name: export-encrypted-data
commands.title: Create Encrypted Export
commands.description: Create a passphrase-protected local backup of your aggregates and settings.

commands.name: import-data
commands.title: Import Local Data
commands.description: Merge a plain or encrypted Writing Signal backup into local Raycast aggregates.

commands.name: keyboard-activity
commands.title: Open Keyboard Activity
commands.description: See optional local keyboard aggregates by foreground app.

commands.name: activity-history
commands.title: Open Activity History
commands.description: Review the last 14 days of local foreground-app time.

commands.name: collector-settings
commands.title: Automatic Tracking Settings
commands.description: Choose when idle time stops counting toward app activity.

commands.name: tracking-pause
commands.title: Pause Automatic Tracking
commands.description: Temporarily stop automatic app and keyboard aggregate collection.
